returns boolean as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 from public.envelope_recipients er
    where er.envelope_id = p_envelope_id and er.user_id = public.current_user_id()
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- Helper function to check if all previous signers in order have signed
create or replace function public.has_previous_signers_signed(p_envelope_id bigint)
returns boolean as $$
declare
  v_min_order integer;
  v_max_order integer;
begin
  -- Get the range of sign_order for the current user's envelope
  select min(sign_order), max(sign_order)
  into v_min_order, v_max_order
  from public.envelope_recipients
  where envelope_id = p_envelope_id;

  if v_min_order is null then
    return false; -- No recipients yet
  end if;

  -- Check if the current user is the first signer
  if v_min_order = v_max_order then
    -- Current user is the first signer, so no previous signers to wait for
    return true;
  end if;

  -- Check if all users with sign_order < v_max_order have signed_at is not null
  return not exists (
    select 1 from public.envelope_recipients er2
    where er2.envelope_id = p_envelope_id
    and er2.sign_order < v_max_order
    and er2.signed_at is null
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- Helper function to check if caller is the next signer in line

returns boolean as $$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_next_order integer;
begin

  select sign_order into v_next_order
  from public.envelope_recipients
  where envelope_id = p_envelope_id and user_id = public.current_user_id();

  return public.has_previous_signers_signed(p_envelope_id);
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

create or replace function public.has_previous_signers_signed(p_envelope_id bigint)
returns boolean as $$

  v_min_order integer;
  v_max_order integer;

  -- Get the range of sign_order for the current user's envelope
  select min(sign_order), max(sign_order)
  into v_min_order, v_max_order

  where envelope_id = p_envelope_id;

  if v_min_order = v_max_order then

    return true;

  return not exists (

    where er2.envelope_id = p_envelope_id
